0.001 Lux minimum illumination at F1.0 (color, 30 IRE), 0 Lux with illuminator on
120 dB True WDR, 3D DNR, HLC, BLC

Intelligent analytics: VCA, face detection, people counting, video metadata, heat map, X Search

frigate.notes: LTS Platinum/LX line = Hikvision-OEM. The Hikvision /Streaming/Channels/101 (main) & 102 (sub) RTSP convention typically applies; ONVIF must be manually enabled (off by default on Hikvision firmware v5.5.0+). Not independently confirmed for this exact model.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-OEM; enable ONVIF first, then add via the ONVIF integration.

blue_iris.notes: Hikvision-OEM RTSP/ONVIF; not independently confirmed for this specific model.
